_comment: One color per manager, used on every tab and in every season. Keys are canonical names (see aliases.json). Current managers keep the hue they knew from This Week; former managers were then placed one at a time, longest tenure first, each as far as possible from every color already taken (about 10-12 OKLab dE is the most the navy background leaves room for). Validated against the card background #163146: every color >= 3:1 contrast, the current twelve >= 15 OKLab dE apart (normal vision) and >= 7.5 under protan/deutan simulation. A new manager needs an entry here (tests/test_teamcolors.py fails until it exists); re-run the dataviz palette validator with the new season's twelve before choosing it. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
